properties.name: Congo Basin
properties.subtitle: Democratic Republic of the Congo (regional)
properties.claim: Episodes invoke the Congo for reports of Mokele-mbembe, for Ndoki forest legends of beings descending from the sky, and for uranium from Shinkolobwe feeding the first atomic weapons — framed as knowledge directed from outside.
properties.context: No specimen, bone or verified photograph of Mokele-mbembe exists after more than a century of expeditions. Shinkolobwe's uranium supply to the Manhattan Project is thoroughly documented colonial economic history. The basin's actual scientific significance lies in its biodiversity and in the Oklo natural fission reactors in neighbouring Gabon — a geological, not engineered, phenomenon.
properties.summary: The Congo Basin is the sedimentary basin of the Congo River. The Congo Basin is located in Central Africa, in a region known as west equatorial Africa. The region is sometimes known simply as the Congo.
properties.short_description: Sedimentary basin of the Congo River in Central Africa
